#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Point {
    int a, b, c, d, e;
    Point() : a(0), b(0), c(0), d(0), e(0) {}
    Point(int a, int b, int c, int d, int e) : a(a), b(b), c(c), d(d), e(e) {}
    Point minus(const Point& o) const {
        return Point(a - o.a, b - o.b, c - o.c, d - o.d, e - o.e);
    }
    double magnitude() const {
        return sqrt(1.0 * a * a + b * b + c * c + d * d + e * e);
    }
};

bool isAcute(const Point& u, const Point& v) {
    double mu = u.magnitude();
    double mv = v.magnitude();
    int dot = u.a * v.a + u.b * v.b + u.c * v.c + u.d * v.d + u.e * v.e;
    double angle = acos(dot / (mu * mv));
    return (angle * 180.0 / M_PI) < 90.0;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    if (n > 11) {
        cout << "0\n";
        return 0;
    }
    vector<Point> arr;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int a, b, c, d, e;
        cin >> a >> b >> c >> d >> e;
        arr.emplace_back(a, b, c, d, e);
    }
    set<int> good;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const Point& p = arr[i];
        bool flag = true;
        for (int j = 0; j < n && flag; j++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < n && flag; k++) {
                if (i != j && i != k && j != k) {
                    Point u = arr[j].minus(p);
                    Point v = arr[k].minus(p);
                    if (isAcute(u, v)) {
                        flag = false;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (flag) {
            good.insert(i + 1);
        }
    }
    if (good.empty()) {
        cout << "0\n";
    } else {
        cout << good.size() << "\n";
        for (int idx : good) {
            cout << idx << "\n";
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
